title: Implement extended workforce services
goal: Implement availability, request, credential, conflict, attendance, actual-time, cost, payroll, and export services over canonical assignments.

in: Attendance evidence, correction, and actual-time approval
Forecast, payroll readiness, export, and reconciliation APIs
out: Treating worker evidence as approved time

working_set: types/workforce/extended.ts (extended types only; WFC-005 owns the base types)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: DST, recurrence, overnight work, missing checkout, delayed evidence, and duplicate events are deterministic
Overrides and corrections require capability, reason, actor, and audit
Forecast uses planned time while payroll uses approved actual time
Export versions reconcile exactly and unapproved time cannot export
Financial values and source metadata are redacted without capability

progress.summary: Blocked on scheduling services and the extended schema/RLS contract.
next_steps: CP-103 partition: attendance, conflicts, conversions, identity-merge, and payroll-exports under app/api/admin/workforce/** are yours. These five of the seven live routes already exist, so your first act is to disposition each one: adopt, reconcile, or return to its named owner.
lib/workforce/extended/** is your subtree. Do not write into lib/workforce/scheduling, lib/workforce/actions, or lib/workforce/read-model.
Attendance, actual time, and payroll time are distinct from manager operational status and from worker evidence (CP-095, CP-096). Do not collapse them.
Payroll and cost surfaces are financially sensitive: any monetary value you emit must be traceable to a source read, and an unavailable source must never become 0 (CP-098).

CP-103 partition: claim only your own subtrees of app/api/admin/workforce/**. WFC-005/012/014/019 previously each claimed the whole tree, which already contains seven live routes (attendance, conflicts, conversions, health, identity-merge, payroll-exports, people).
Before authoring anything, disposition each route in your subtrees: adopt as-is, reconcile, or leave to its named owner. Do not write a parallel second implementation.
Add temporal, correction, financial, redaction, and reconciliation tests

handoffs: Work → Admin: extended workforce APIs and types for WFC-020
Work → QA: temporal, conflict, correction, redaction, and payroll fixtures
